title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.17816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. translated_title: 赋能边缘智能体：LLM智能体执行中边缘-云协同的系统性分析
translated_abstract: 边缘-云协同将边缘侧执行较低的推理开销和更强的数据局部性，与云端托管模型更强大的能力相结合。然而，随着LLM智能体越来越多地在长时程场景中运行，云端的参与变得贯穿于整个执行过程之中，而非针对每个查询的一次性决策。这种交错的参与方式引入了轨迹层面的影响，而这些影响目前尚未得到充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们提出了EC2-Bench，一个用于评估长时程智能体执行中边缘-云协同的基准。该基准提供了可执行的数字工作空间智能体任务，以及一个涵盖任务性能、资源使用和隐私暴露的统一评估框架。利用这一基准，我们对多种形式的边缘-云协同进行了实证研究。我们的研究揭示了三个发现。首先，协同在任务性能、资源使用与隐私暴露之间实现了有利的平衡……
tldr: 提出EC2-Bench基准，首次系统性地评估长时程LLM智能体执行中的边缘-云协同，通过涵盖任务性能、资源使用和隐私暴露的统一框架，揭示了协同模式的三个关键实证发现。
en_tdlr: We introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark that systematically evaluates edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon LLM agent execution, providing a unified framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure, and revealing three key empirical findings on collaboration patterns.
